caption: The drawing depicts a detailed side view of a rooster, rendered in grayscale. The rooster stands on a horizontal cylindrical rod with both feet visible, and a vertical support runs through the middle connecting it to the rod. The bird is facing to the right, and its body is covered in meticulously shaded feathers, with distinct feather patterns on the wings and tail. The wings are outstretched and the tail feathers are elongated and fanned out. The comb and wattle of the rooster are clearly defined, and the beak is pointed. There is a faint rectangular border surrounding the drawing, and a small scale bar is shown in the lower left corner indicating measurements in inches. The background is plain, and the artist's name, "ISIDORE SOVENSKY," is written near the bottom left edge of the paper. The overall composition is precise and rendered in pencil or graphite on off-white paper.
title: Weather Vane
